buildingsModelled.note: Buildings with their own individually modelled 3D model in the ride: 327 landmark models plus 160 individually modelled ordinary buildings and blocks (the game's draw list, manual + ordinary catalogues).

landmarkModels.note: Of the individually modelled buildings, the ones in the landmark category (museums, churches, stations, monuments…).

kitBuildings.note: Buildings drawn from a reusable building-type kit (72 kit designs placed on their real footprints, mostly Nieuw-West).

buildings3d.note: Every building in the 3D city: BAG footprints with 3DBAG heights, including the modelled ones.

placesToVisit.note: Destinations you can ride to and collect a stamp at: the ride's stamp pool (teachable landmarks within 4 km of the centre plus the individually modelled POIs, deduplicated).

factsToDiscover.note: Cards and facts the ride and quiz can show: 2351 trivia facts, 5429 street/canal/bridge name origins, 156 neighbourhood story facts and 180 landmark descriptions.

triviaFacts.note: Trivia facts on streets, canals, bridges, squares, parks and landmarks.

nameOrigins.note: Official explanations of where a street, canal or bridge name comes from (BAG beschrijvingNaam, in English).

bridgeRegister.note: Bridges with a municipal register entry (number, material, movable or fixed).

streetsAndCanals.note: Names you can be asked: 5225 streets on rideable ways (bridge decks are counted under named bridges) and 300 canals and waters.

namedBridges.note: Named bridges the "which bridge are you on?" question can ask.

neighbourhoods.note: Neighbourhoods with a postcard to collect (recall one on two different days, once by pinning it on the map).

tours.note: Themed tours with a tour stamp for finishing.

zooAnimals.note: ARTIS zoo animals placed in the ride, one miniature per species at its enclosure.
